purpose: A single, untimed diagnostic invocation for the test-only DOCX existing-section-layout provider phase-counter helper. It records deterministic counters and correctness identities so the helper's phase boundaries can be reviewed without creating a performance cohort.
adr_basis: 0005 positional I/O, budgets, and measured evidence
0030 lazy OPC decode behind fallible accessors

full_source_listing.repo_descriptor: retain only path, byte count, SHA-256, and regeneration command

source_binding.workspace_policy: Compile only the reviewed base plus the exact test-only helper patch. Do not include unrelated working-tree files, generated targets, historical evidence, iWork records, or production edits.

toolchain_binding.final_receipt_rule: The final invocation receipt must record the actual rustc -Vv and cargo -V output hashes, final manifest and lock hashes, profile, target, relevant environment, and any changed values.

required_properties: run from the clean source checkout or an explicitly recorded equivalent
use the reviewed manifest and lock with --locked
use no native benchmark runner, profiler, heap sampler, or child performance process
write one diagnostic JSON output and retain stdout/stderr hashes
record exit status and test-binary identity
command_binding.no_placeholder_acceptance: A receipt is invalid until the exact command string is populated; the planned shape is not execution evidence.

test_binary_binding.identity_rule: The final receipt must hash the exact test binary selected by the command and must reject a missing, swapped, or post-build-mutated binary.

corpus_binding.identity_rule: The diagnostic may report counters only when the source and output identities match these retained corpus bindings and the helper's semantic and inverse checks pass.

required_sections: integer phase-counter values with explicit phase names and boundary descriptions
integer provider/source counters with explicit scope and unavailable values represented as null
semantic reopen and exact inverse/preservation checks
exact command, exit status, stdout/stderr hashes, and test-binary SHA-256
forbidden_claims: p50, p95, p99, speedup, throughput, RSS, allocation, or memory claim
physical filesystem or network I/O claim from wrapper counters
diagnostic_output_contract.raw_stdout_policy: Keep verbose stdout/stderr and any full source listing outside the repository; retain only compact hashes, sizes, and regeneration paths here.

release_conditions: candidate_review approves the test-only helper and exact changed-file allowlist
source receipt binds base revision plus exact patch and external full listing
toolchain and lock/profile receipt is complete
test binary is built once in an external target and its SHA-256 is recorded
reviewer confirms the actual output schema and no timing fields are being interpreted as timing evidence
execution_gate.failure_policy: Do not rerun or replace a diagnostic invocation after a malformed output, timeout, or identity mismatch. Preserve the original output and record the failure; this plan authorizes no fresh formal cohort.
